The guide requires a GitHub Personal Access Token for private packages. The token wasn't available. So frontend could not be installed. But is the whole software "Erlebnis.Stadt Menden" complete? The web app (app/) is the main end-user app. CMS also. Neither installed. That's a major incompleteness.

Let me verify the app/cms state more thoroughly and confirm pnpm install indeed fails. Actually validation boundaries: do not install deps, but running a check that fails is okay as evidence? Running pnpm install would be attempting install — prohibited. Better just verify no node_modules and the lockfile references private registry. I already have summary's evidence.
